system: BTC Signal Pro Elite Institutional Intelligence

market_regime.note: Rule-based regime classification, not a forecast.

volume_profile.method: 15m typical-price volume bins; last 400 candles maximum
volume_profile.note: Estimated profile from candle volume, not exchange tick-level volume-at-price.

options.note: Aggregated listed BTC options snapshot; max-pain is an approximation across returned instruments, not a price target.

macro_correlations.note: Yahoo Finance hourly proxy correlations; asynchronous market hours and feed gaps can reduce comparability.

15m.note: Heuristic scenario, not a calibrated probability or an entry signal.

30m.note: Heuristic scenario, not a calibrated probability or an entry signal.

1h.note: Heuristic scenario, not a calibrated probability or an entry signal.

signal_quality_gate.policy: Directional signals remain blocked until AI validation beats the majority baseline, macro-F1 is >=30, shadow sample >=30, beats its own majority-class baseline and passes its validation, and a >=300-candle cost-aware holdout backtest is positive.
signal_quality_gate.note: This is a conservative evidence gate, not proof of future profitability.

shadow_evaluation.classification_note: Includes LONG, SHORT and WAIT forecasts. Labels use the same 15m volatility-adaptive neutral band as the AI training target.

latest_venue_alignment.reason: Same-venue or cross-venue BTC perpetual prices and 5m candle times are aligned.

shadow_evaluation.note: Research-only forecast tracking. Each fresh model generation is counted once; same-venue Futures or cross-venue Futures with <=0.25% price basis and <=15-minute candle skew may be scored. Spot, stale, mismatched or unaligned feeds are abstentions. Forecasts never authorize trades.

items.name: executed_taker_flow
items.detail: exchange taker buy/sell volume feed; not account positioning

items.name: rolling_cvd
items.detail: latest aggregate trades only; not exchange-wide historical CVD

items.name: trump_public_post_archive
items.detail: unofficial third-party RSS archive; may lag or omit posts

feed_health.note: A feed marked unavailable is not guessed or replaced. This audit reports source presence and freshness, not signal accuracy. GitHub Actions sampled liquidation data does not count as a continuous stream.

disclaimer: Public-data research context only. Scenarios are not calibrated probabilities; unavailable feeds are explicitly marked.
